name: Momose Souichi
source:
A first-year who met Ryou and the others after an incident.

He knew of the Light Hunters and declared his intent to help fight them.

He has no special ability, but he makes up for it with guts and enthusiasm.

Despite his dirty mouth, he’s solemn at heart.

(from Kagura Games' website)
